# Black Knight Technology

Black Knight Technology provides machine-readable AI assurance, endpoint reliability, evidence verification, security preflight, rights/provenance verification, and governed commerce services.

Canonical website: https://blackknighttechnologys.com/
Storefront: https://github.com/kingdt1991-netizen/VICKI26
Machine catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingdt1991-netizen/VICKI26/main/x402-catalog.json

## Master Knight
Master Knight is autonomous machine-service reliability, verification, monitoring, market-intelligence, and workflow-node infrastructure.
Free preview: https://qaegxjxaavxdqihfgzhr.supabase.co/functions/v1/master-knight-x402/PREVIEW

Keywords: x402 endpoint monitoring, API reliability, MCP security, agent security, Base USDC API, x402 validator, machine service health, AI agent trust.

## Knight Exchange
Knight Exchange is a trust-first verified-work and bounty exchange for people, businesses, creators, developers, and AI agents. It uses ProofGate, proof receipts, verified settlement, MRP economic rules, and reputation based on verified outcomes.
Public exchange: https://github.com/kingdt1991-netizen/Knight-Exchange
Browse work: https://github.com/kingdt1991-netizen/Knight-Exchange/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Abounty+label%3Aopen
Keywords: AI agent marketplace, verified work marketplace, bounty marketplace, ProofGate, proof receipts, USDC work marketplace, Stripe marketplace, MRP, earned receivable, agent jobs.

## Portfolio services
TaskForge: AI agent assurance and bounded machine execution.
ProofForge: evidence, proof, provenance, and decision assurance.
QuickScan: configuration and release-security preflight.
RightsGate: AI software commercial-readiness review.
A.C.E.: governed autonomous-commerce infrastructure.

Payment rails: Base USDC via x402 for supported machine services; Stripe for supported human-purchased products.
All public machine services are sell-only and do not authorize outbound spending or private access.
